title: Device Mockups
note: Device Mockups generator — builds iPhone/MacBook/Browser/iPad/Android frame groups on the canvas. Extracted VERBATIM from app.js section 21b (initMockups). Lazy-only: the gallery module's openToolGenerator('mockups') creates a fresh #mockup-grid then calls window.initMockups to populate it. The old app.js init-time initMockups() call was dead code (#mockup-grid never exists at load) and was removed.
